description: This file defines a Java interface named CacheManager that declares methods for managing cache components, specifically an EmbeddedCacheManager and a TreeCache, within a CMS module.

classes.name: CacheManager
classes.description: A Java interface for cache management providing access to EmbeddedCacheManager and TreeCache instances.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the EmbeddedCacheManager instance used for cache operations.

methods.name: getTreeCache
methods.description: Returns the TreeCache instance used for hierarchical cache operations.
